session_context: Seller session context (use without asking): merchant/entityId = A2U949TIRMCSK5, marketplace = US (ATVPDKIKX0DER). Do NOT ask the seller for these — use them directly.

evals.prompt: Why can't customers buy my glass storage jars (GLASS-JAR-12)?
